businesses.business: First aid supplies and cutting tools

offering_description.value: Sells first aid kits, refill supplies and spill cleanup products for workplaces and households. It also sells scissors, other cutting tools and sharpeners for schools, offices, crafts and home use. It manufactures some products, sources others from contract manufacturers and sells through distributors, retailers and online stores.

primary_products.value: first aid kits and cabinets; bandages, wipes and over-the-counter first aid medicines; scissors and other cutting tools; blade sharpeners; spill absorbents

customer_segment.value: B2B: Workplace safety distributors, employers, schools, office supply retailers and craft retailers; B2C: Households, home crafters and consumers buying first aid supplies or cutting tools

end_markets.value: workplace safety; household first aid; education and office supplies; arts and crafts; hardware and home improvement

revenue_model.value: product sales: First aid kits and refills, cutting and sharpening tools, and spill cleanup supplies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Makes first aid supplies and assembles kits from components for distributors and retailers; brand owner: Sources contract-made cutting tools and other branded goods for retailers and distributors

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada and Europe, with sourcing and operations in Asia

specialization.value: diversified: Workplace first aid and spill control supplies, plus cutting and sharpening tools for education, office, craft and hardware buyers

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Workplace safety, industrial and office supply distributors; third-party retail: Mass-market, office supply, craft and hardware retailers; online: Company web stores and third-party marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA rules apply to over-the-counter first aid medicines and regulated medical devices such as bandages.

notes: Direct sales to government agencies are uncertain.
